description: This file contains unit tests for the DefaultMessageMapperRegistry class within the org.eclipse.ditto.services.connectivity.mapping package. It sets up mock MessageMapper instances, initializes the registry, and verifies correct mapper retrieval behavior, including fallback handling.

classes.name: DefaultMessageMapperRegistryTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for DefaultMessageMapperRegistry, testing mapper retrieval with various payload mappings and fallback logic.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mock message mappers and the registry before each test.

methods.name: testMapperRegistry
methods.description: Verifies that the registry returns the correct mappers for different payload mappings, respecting precedence and fallback rules.

methods.name: testNonExistentMapperResolvesToDefaultMapper
methods.description: Ensures that requesting mappers for a non-existent mapping results in the default mapper being returned.
